article.title: Modalidad -(으)ㄹ 테니까
article.part: Conectores y modalidad avanzada — 고급 연결과 양태
article.chapter: Modalidad avanzada, expectativa y plausibilidad — 고급 양태·예상·개연성

claims.sectionKey: La construcción -(으)ㄹ 테니까 presenta una intención firme del hablante o una suposición sobre una situación futura
claims.summary: The construction -(으)ㄹ 테니까 expresses a firm intention or assumption about a future situation and uses this idea as a basis for what follows.

claims.sectionKey: El valor exacto depende especialmente de quién realiza la acción
claims.summary: The exact value of -(으)ㄹ 테니까 depends on who performs the action.

claims.sectionKey: Con primera persona suele expresar intención
claims.summary: With first person, -(으)ㄹ 테니까 usually expresses intention.

claims.sectionKey: Con otros sujetos o con fenómenos externos, suele expresar expectativa o inferencia
claims.summary: With other subjects or external phenomena, -(으)ㄹ 테니까 usually expresses expectation or inference.

claims.sectionKey: En 예시, 제가 확인할 테니까 잠시만 기다려 주세요
claims.summary: In the example 제가 확인할 테니까 잠시만 기다려 주세요, the speaker's intention to check something is presented as a reason for the request.

claims.sectionKey: En otro ejemplo, 길이 막힐 테니까 조금 일찍 출발합시다
claims.summary: In the example 길이 막힐 테니까 조금 일찍 출발합시다, the prediction of traffic is presented as a reason for the suggestion to leave earlier.

claims.sectionKey: En otro ejemplo, 그 사람도 곧 알게 될 테니까 지금은 말하지 않아도 돼요
claims.summary: In the example 그 사람도 곧 알게 될 테니까 지금은 말하지 않아도 돼요, the expectation that someone will learn something soon is presented as a reason for not saying anything now.
